prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:3 analog VHS fashion portrait of an adult East Asian woman with dark brown hair in a loose updo and wispy bangs, centered against an infinite solid-purple studio background. Use a high top-down 8mm fisheye viewpoint. She has a feminine silhouette and wears a dark brown lace-trim fashion camisole with coordinated high-waisted shorts. Keep a calm direct gaze and a natural arms-behind posture with a gentle head tilt. Use a soft 4300K violet key and warm low-intensity fill to create subtle shadows shaping her shoulders and chest area through the outfit. Render strong physical VHS degradation: rounded CRT frame edges, heavy tape grain, chromatic aberration, scanlines, tracking noise, and softened detail. No text, logo, watermark, or sexualized framing.
